references.text: The person with a skin disease shall live outside the camp as long as the disease lasts and keep away from the community.
The Israelites must be kept apart from their uncleanness so that they do not die in their impurity by defiling the Lord's dwelling place.
Miriam was shut out of the camp for seven days because of a skin disease, an example of how those who were unclean were sent outside the camp.
Those who had become unclean by touching a dead body had to stay outside the camp for seven days.
Your God walks in the midst of your camp; therefore the camp must be holy, and nothing indecent shall be found there.
God dwells among his people, so the sanctuary and the camp must be kept clean.
The Lord promises to dwell among the children of Israel and be their God.
God sets his dwelling among the people and walks among them as their God.
Nothing unclean shall enter the new Jerusalem, only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life.
